name: reporter_cluster_tables_S_patterns
description: Tests: Table edge-case patterns S27 (percent scaling), S28 (decimal precision), S40 (event count), S48 (ffill stat distortion), S81 (table formatting). Each pattern in its own category exercising the specific pitfalls documented in each skill.
source:
# ========================================================================
# Tables S Patterns — Edge Case Coverage
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v
ts = index()

# === Core Derived Series ===
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
cum_ret = agg(daily_ret, AggregationType.Sum)
sma_20 = sma(close, 20)
sma_50 = sma(close, 50)
rsi_14 = rsi(close, 14)

# Date components
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)

# ========================================================================
# S27: Percent Scaling
# PercentFormat MULTIPLIES raw value x100. Pass 0-1 range, never pre-scaled.
# ========================================================================

# S27a: CORRECT — raw return (0-1 range) + PercentFormat = proper display
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='S27a Percent Scaling: Raw + PercentFormat (correct)',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Raw Returns with PercentFormat',
      row_size=1, col_size=3,
      col_headers=['Mean Return', 'Best Day', 'Worst Day'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(daily_ret, daily_ret, daily_ret)

# S27b: CORRECT — pre-scaled (x100) + DecimalFormat = proper display
scaled_ret = daily_ret * 100
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='S27b Percent Scaling: Pre-scaled + DecimalFormat (correct)',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Pre-scaled Returns with DecimalFormat',
      row_size=1, col_size=3,
      col_headers=['Mean Return %', 'Best Day %', 'Worst Day %'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(scaled_ret, scaled_ret, scaled_ret)

# S27c: CORRECT — counts with IntegerFormat, dollar amounts with MonetaryFormat
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='S27c Percent Scaling: Integer + Monetary types',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Count and Dollar Metrics',
      row_size=1, col_size=3,
      col_headers=['Observations', 'Avg Volume', 'Last Close'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(close, volume, close)

# S27d: cs_summary_table — raw hit rate (0-1) with PercentFormat
rsi_bullish = rsi_14 > 50
hit_rate = agg(100.0 if rsi_bullish else 0.0, AggregationType.Mean) / 100.0
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Hit Rate (raw 0-1 + PercentFormat)',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI>50 Hit Rate', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title='Cum Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
      ]),
    category='S27d Percent Scaling: cs_table Hit Rate'
)((hit_rate, cum_ret))

# ========================================================================
# S28: Decimal Precision
# Match dp to data type. Returns dp=2-3, prices dp=2, ratios dp=1,
# counts dp=0. Beware dp=6 on tiny values (variance at 1e-10).
# ========================================================================

# S28a: Correct dp per data type — returns, prices, ratios, counts
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='S28a Decimal Precision: Mixed dp values',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Precision by Data Type',
      row_size=2, col_size=3,
      row_headers=['Returns', 'Prices/Ratios'],
      col_headers=['dp=2', 'dp=3 (small ret)', 'dp=0 (count)'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]))
(daily_ret, daily_ret, daily_ret, close, rsi_14, close)

# S28b: cs_summary_table — dp per asset-class convention
ret_std = agg(daily_ret, 20, AggregationType.Std)
ret_var = ret_std * ret_std
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Precision Edge Cases',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Price (dp=2)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI (dp=1)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title='Volatility (dp=4)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title='Variance (dp=6)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=6)
      ]),
    category='S28b Decimal Precision: Edge dp values'
)(close, rsi_14, ret_std, ret_var)

# S28c: BpsFormat auto-scales x10000 — pass raw decimal
rate_change = daily_ret
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='BPS Auto-Scaling (raw decimal input)',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Avg Return (bps)', type=CardRenderType.BpsFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title='Avg Return (%)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(title='Avg Return (raw)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=6)
      ]),
    category='S28c Decimal Precision: BPS vs Percent vs Raw'
)((daily_ret, daily_ret, daily_ret))

# ========================================================================
# S40: Event Count Aggregation Pattern
# Use Count on where()-filtered series, not Sum on boolean counters.
# ========================================================================

# S40a: CORRECT — Count on where-filtered series = exact event count
is_bullish = rsi_14 > 60
bullish_return = where(is_bullish, daily_ret)
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='S40a Event Count: where + Count (correct)',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Bullish RSI Events (Count on where-filtered)',
      row_size=1, col_size=3,
      col_headers=['Event Count', 'Avg Return', 'Max Return'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(bullish_return, bullish_return, bullish_return)

# S40b: Multiple event conditions — same where+Count pattern
is_bearish = rsi_14 < 40
bearish_return = where(is_bearish, daily_ret)
high_vol = volume > sma(volume, 20) * 1.5
high_vol_return = where(high_vol, daily_ret)
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='S40b Event Count: Multi-condition',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Event Counts Across Conditions',
      row_size=2, col_size=2,
      row_headers=['RSI Bearish (<40)', 'High Volume (>1.5x avg)'],
      col_headers=['Event Count', 'Avg Return'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(bearish_return, bearish_return, high_vol_return, high_vol_return)

# S40c: cs_summary_table — event count per asset with where+Count
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    title='Event Counts Per Asset (where-filtered)',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Bullish Days', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Bearish Days', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='High Vol Days', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]),
    category='S40c Event Count: cs_table per-asset'
)((bullish_return, bearish_return, high_vol_return))

# S40d: RowSpec with event count by month — Count on where-filtered
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    category='S40d Event Count: RowSpec monthly',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Bullish RSI Events by Month',
      col_headers=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'],
      rows=[
        RowSpec(name='Count', agg=AggregationType.Count,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        RowSpec(name='Avg Return', agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(bullish_return, month_num)

# ========================================================================
# S48: Forward-Fill Statistics Distortion
# Pass sparse series directly to tables. ffill inflates observation
# count and overweights extremes. ffill is fine for rendering only.
# ========================================================================

# S48a: CORRECT — sparse series directly to summary_table (NaN handled correctly)
# Simulate sparse: only non-null on bullish days
sparse_metric = where(is_bullish, daily_ret)
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='S48a FFill Distortion: Sparse direct (correct)',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Sparse Series Stats (no ffill)',
      row_size=1, col_size=4,
      col_headers=['Count', 'Mean', 'Std', 'Max'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(sparse_metric, sparse_metric, sparse_metric, sparse_metric)

# S48b: DISTORTED — ffill'd sparse series inflates count, skews stats
# This demonstrates the anti-pattern for validation comparison
dense_metric = ffill(sparse_metric)
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='S48b FFill Distortion: ffill dense (DISTORTED)',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='FFill Dense Stats (inflated observations)',
      row_size=1, col_size=4,
      col_headers=['Count (inflated)', 'Mean (biased)', 'Std (biased)', 'Max'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(dense_metric, dense_metric, dense_metric, dense_metric)

# S48c: cs_summary_table — sparse vs dense comparison per asset
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    title='Sparse vs Dense Observation Count',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Sparse Count', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Dense Count', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]),
    category='S48c FFill Distortion: Count comparison'
)((sparse_metric, dense_metric))

# S48d: Sparse series in RowSpec — NaN handling across months
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    category='S48d FFill Distortion: Sparse RowSpec monthly',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Sparse Event Stats by Month (correct NaN handling)',
      col_headers=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'],
      rows=[
        RowSpec(name='Count', agg=AggregationType.Count,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        RowSpec(name='Mean', agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
      ]))
(sparse_metric, month_num)

# ========================================================================
# S81: Table & Card Formatting (Professional Quant Standards)
# Match CardRenderType to DATA not LABEL. Cover all render types.
# ========================================================================

# S81a: All numeric render types in one table
ret_rank = rank(cum_ret)
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='S81a Table Formatting: All numeric types',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Numeric Render Type Coverage',
      row_size=2, col_size=3,
      row_headers=['Performance', 'Meta'],
      col_headers=['PercentFormat', 'DecimalFormat', 'IntegerFormat'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]))
(cum_ret, close, volume, daily_ret, rsi_14, close)

# S81b: BpsFormat + RankFormat + MonetaryFormat
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='S81b Table Formatting: Bps Rank Monetary',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Specialized Formats',
      row_size=1, col_size=3,
      col_headers=['Return (bps)', 'Rank', 'Close ($)'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.BpsFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.RankFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(daily_ret, ret_rank, close)

# S81c: Date/Time formats — never encode dates as numbers
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='S81c Table Formatting: Date Time formats',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Date & Time Formats',
      row_size=1, col_size=4,
      col_headers=['First Date', 'Last Timestamp', 'Year', 'Month'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.First,
                   type=CardRenderType.DateFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.TimestampFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.YearFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.MonthFormat)
      ]))
(ts, ts, year_num, month_num)

# S81d: TextFormat + BooleanFormat in cs_summary_table
regime = conditional_select(rsi_14 > 50, 'Bullish', 'Bearish')
rsi_above_50 = rsi_14 > 50
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Text and Boolean Formats',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI>50', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2)
      ]),
    category='S81d Table Formatting: Text Boolean'
)(regime, rsi_above_50, rsi_14, close)

# S81e: Professional quant table — mixed asset-class conventions
range_pct = (high - low) / close
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Professional Quant Metrics',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Avg Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='Avg Ret (bps)', type=CardRenderType.BpsFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title='Avg Range %', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='Avg Volume', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]),
    category='S81e Table Formatting: Quant conventions'
)(daily_ret, daily_ret, range_pct, volume)

# S81f: RowSpec with mixed formatting by month
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    category='S81f Table Formatting: RowSpec mixed types',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Monthly Stats with Mixed Formats',
      col_headers=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'],
      rows=[
        RowSpec(name='Avg Return', agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        RowSpec(name='Avg Return (bps)', agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                type=CardRenderType.BpsFormat, dp=1),
        RowSpec(name='Observations', agg=AggregationType.Count,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        RowSpec(name='Best Day', agg=AggregationType.Max,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(daily_ret, month_num)
